name: rtk-codex
description: RTK command rewriting and token-optimized command output for Codex developer workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Rewrite Codex Bash commands through RTK for compact output.
interface.longDescription: Adds RTK skills and a Codex PreToolUse hook that rewrites supported Bash commands to token-optimized RTK equivalents.
defaultPrompt: Use RTK when running shell commands so Codex receives compact command output.
Use $rtk to review RTK command rewriting and opt-out behavior.
